proposals.title: Implement core branded arithmetic types and division modes
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 requires 'core completo. Aritmética inteira' as its first scope item. With the CanonicalEncoder now accepted (TASK-0009), branded types are the next unblocked foundational piece. ADR-003 specifies Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as bigint branded types and Tick as a safe-integer branded number. ADR-004 requires a division helper that enforces explicit rounding mode at the call site. These are prerequisites for every downstream package: world (price generator), domain (ledger, orders, margin), and application (tick loop). They have no dependencies on the hash function ADR and can be implemented immediately.

proposals.title: Write ADR for positional hash function (DEFINIR item from ADR-002)
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 is TRAVADA and explicitly requires the hash function to be 'especificada bit a bit em ADR' before implementation. This is listed in §19 lacunas conhecidas as an expected DEFINIR resolution. Without the ADR, rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates) cannot be correctly implemented or reviewed, which blocks the price generator and all world simulation. The ADR is documentation-only and has no dependencies, so it can be written in parallel with IDEA-001 or immediately after.

proposals.title: Implement two-asset two-octave price generator in packages/world
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 scope explicitly requires 'Gerador de preço com duas camadas de ruído e dois ativos'. This is the minimum world simulation needed to drive the tick loop, the ledger, and the minimal UI chart. ADR-005 defines the tick base as a single point value (no OHLC), and §5.1 defines the layered log-space construction. Two octave layers (trendLayer and idiosyncraticNoise) over two assets (ORB and NEXA) are the minimum viable price signal. This work is blocked only by branded types (IDEA-001) and the positional RNG (IDEA-003).

proposals.title: Minimal Electron installer for Windows and Linux (FASE-1 requirement)
proposals.why_now: §14.6 states 'o instalador existe na FASE-1, em forma mínima. Não no fim.' The spec explicitly warns that deferring multi-platform packaging to a later phase means discovering ABI and module-native issues in the final week when there is no time to fix architecture. The current apps/desktop/* sub-apps are stubs. INV-29 (contextIsolation, nodeIntegration: false, sandbox) must be wired from the first installer. This work has no dependency on core arithmetic or the price generator and can proceed in parallel.

repository_assessment.current_state: Two tasks accepted in total: TASK-0002 (monorepo scaffold, checkpoint-0007) and TASK-0009 (CanonicalEncoder + ADR-009, checkpoint-0035). packages/core contains canonical-encoder.mts and its index only; all other packages (world, domain, application, contracts, adapters, narrative, ui) are empty stubs exporting {}. Only one ADR document exists (0009-canonical-encoding.md). No branded arithmetic types, no hash function ADR, no positional RNG, no price generator, no ledger, no tick loop, no save/replay system, no installer, and no UI exist anywhere in the codebase.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: core branded arithmetic types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick) and division modes (ADR-003, ADR-004) are the next unblocked FASE-1 deliverable. They are prerequisites for every downstream package and have no remaining dependencies now that the CanonicalEncoder is accepted.

warnings: The hash function ADR (DEFINIR item from ADR-002) has not been written. ADR-002 is TRAVADA and explicitly requires the algorithm to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any implementation of rand(). Implementing the positional RNG without a prior ADR risks the same multi-cycle review rejection pattern seen with the CanonicalEncoder before ADR-009 was written.

The minimal installer is a FASE-1 acceptance criterion, not a later-phase item. §14.6 states the requirement explicitly and warns that deferral causes ABI and module-native failures in the final week. The longer this is deferred within FASE-1, the higher the integration risk for multi-platform CI.

INV-29 (Electron security: contextIsolation, nodeIntegration: false, sandbox) has no test coverage and no configured CI audit step yet. The gate in §17 item 8 requires this audit to be blocking before FASE-1 can close.
